name: Muhibbah Engineering (M) Bhd.
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股份分拆/附加上市、股息除权及股东大会等公司治理事项，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长16.5%，净利润同比下降32.3%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered share subdivision/additional listing, dividend ex-date, and general meeting matters, with no disclosure of business segment expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue increased 16.5% year-on-year while net profit decreased 32.3%.
